PRODUCTION SERVICES AGREEMENT Date: March 4, 2026 This Production Services Agreement (“Agreement”) is between Harbor Media Inc. (“Client”) and Luna Park Studio (“Vendor”). 1. Scope of Services Vendor will perform production services described in Statement of Work (SOW), Exhibit A, and technical specifications in Appendix 1, all incorporated by reference. If any exhibit is unavailable at signing, Vendor will still perform services requested by Client. 2. Fees and Payment Total project fee is $18,000. Client pays 30% deposit and remainder within Net 60 days after invoice. 3. Term and Termination Term starts on the Effective Date and continues until completion. Client may terminate for convenience on 7 days notice. Vendor may terminate for nonpayment after 30 days overdue notice. 4. Intellectual Property Upon full payment, final approved deliverables are assigned to Client. Vendor retains ownership of pre-existing tools and portfolio rights unless prohibited by Client in writing. 5. Confidentiality Vendor will keep Client confidential information private for 3 years. 6. Indemnity and Liability Vendor will indemnify Client for third-party claims arising from Vendor’s breach or negligence. Client will indemnify Vendor for claims arising from Client-provided materials. Except for fraud, willful misconduct, and confidentiality breach, each party’s liability is capped at amounts paid under this Agreement. 7. Disputes and Governing Law Any dispute first goes to mediation, then binding arbitration in Seattle, Washington. Governing law is the State of Washington. 8. Assignment and Subcontracting Vendor may subcontract portions of work to qualified contractors but remains responsible for deliverables. Neither party may assign this Agreement without written consent, except in a merger. 9. Warranties Vendor warrants deliverables will substantially conform to written specifications for 30 days after delivery. Signed: Harbor Media Inc. ___________________ Luna Park Studio ___________________
